verdict.rationale: The product is a skill pack that runs inside host agents. A skill set could plausibly be designed for headless or CI use, so the axis applies. The evidence shows CLI install and update commands (`npx skills add`/`update`, plugin installs) and triage labels that hand work to an 'AFK agent'. None of it documents running the skills non-interactively or in CI pipelines. Many core skills, such as TDD and grilling, require confirming with the user, which works against headless runs.
